name: AttachmentUploader
tagline: The Attachment Uploader lets people attach photos and documents to a record in one place.
description: The Attachment Uploader lets people attach photos and documents to a record in one place. They can drag files in, choose them from the device, take a photo with the phone camera or paste a screenshot. The control checks every file straight away (type, size, number of files and total size), makes large photos smaller so they upload quickly, and asks for the details your process needs, such as a category and a caption.
features: Take a photo on phones or paste a screenshot, type, size
Count and total-size limits with clear reasons for rejected files
Thumbnails and a preview dialog (images, PDF, text)
Categories (e.g. Before / After / Receipt) with required counts, captions, rename, reorder
Already-uploaded attachments (SharePoint / Dataverse notes JSON) with remove marking
List or grid layout, phone layout
